gating: Phase 1 steps 1–2 only: map and plan, no source/tests implemented. After checkpoint review, write failing tests first. Within each checkpoint run unit → api → cli → ui and stop at the first failed layer; API here means injected collector/writer integration, not a live Azure request. UI comparison follows behavior and independent review follows UI. All cases reference the matching checkpoint verify commands.

unit.case: Normalize comments by documented id or example commentId with matching workItemId/version/dates; reject conflicting aliases, invalid/duplicate IDs, malformed timestamps and incoherent pages. Distinct opaque continuation tokens are encoded as query values and cannot replace the route/version. Deleted tombstones contribute to complete totals, never claims; author/identity/mention/reaction payloads are not retained.

One frozen clock computes creation age and time since change across Z/offset timestamps, midnight, leap day and DST; elapsed-day boundaries are exact. Missing/invalid/future dates and changed-before-created are explicit non-assessable signals, never NaN, negative age, continuously-open claims, or urgency.

Only documented Microsoft.VSTS.Scheduling.DueDate/TargetDate references with dateTime metadata gain due/target meaning. Custom date fields already returned retain their exact reference names/values as visibly unrecognized context with unknown semantics and no ranking effect; no caller mapping or configurable projection is accepted. Custom lookalike names, wrong type, null/absent/invalid values, unavailable metadata and conflicting dates retain distinct coverage; StartDate/FinishDate do not become delivery promises.

Selected-team iteration lookup uses exact path, never name, current fallback or integer/UUID equality; normalize explicit value/values envelopes without accepting conflicting shapes. UTC date-only sprint boundaries are inclusive. Unmatched paths, null dates, duplicate paths, invalid/reversed ranges, and inaccessible reads carry reason/next action and no implied deadline. Parent priority/dates remain context.

Validate each structured claim against its actual item's source IDs, matching field/excerpt/value/parent/date and correct team-reported/code-verified provenance. Missing references, cross-item/parent mismatches, unsupported claims, invented quotations and an ordinary HTTPS link claimed as code verification fail closed.

A native critical bug and a lower-priority commitment tomorrow retain critical-first order, unchanged Priority/Severity/bands and visible conflicting reasons. Grounded current overdue/today/within-seven-days commitments and explicit unresolved blockers share an attention group with native/stable tie-breaks; eight-days-away, forecast-only, fulfilled/unknown-current and absent evidence keep native order.

An old ticket with many comments gets relevance review after 30 idle days without rank promotion; fresh activity does not create urgency. A priority-1 parent with dates does not promote its child without an explicit matching outstanding dependency/current commitment. Expired sprint yields planning review rather than overdue delivery; literal workflow state alone changes no recommendation.

Later explicit resolution of the same blocker removes its old promotion; unrelated resolution does not. Old comment edits versus later resolution remain a conflict instead of a fabricated current blocker. Partial discussion cannot prove an unresolved blocker or absence; valid independent field evidence remains usable with limited coverage. Fallback and UNASSESSED retain exact native/stable order and next actions.

api.case: A fake CLI records exact bare az rest arguments, explicit resource/scope, route-specific 7.1/7.1-preview.4, allowed query keys and encoded tokens. Comment reads for unselected IDs, cross-project/team scope, wrong version, raw nextPage URLs, arbitrary fields, request bodies on GET, unsafe batch keys, >200 IDs and mutation routes are rejected before any CLI execution.

Collect more than one full page of synthetic comments through every token to terminal count reconciliation; verify exact content/source IDs/dates and absent-complete zero comments. Repeated tokens, malformed/duplicate/mislinked pages, changing totals, contradictory continuation metadata, missing last page and buffer/timeout interruption retain explicit partial evidence without full/no-blocker claims.

Exact selected backlog membership and literal terminal/custom states survive enrichment; batching stays <=200, inventory IDs/counts are unchanged, and parent/child evidence cannot add rows. Below-known-cap succeeds; missing/at-cap completeness, missing mandatory details/related context, ambiguity and auth stop before writer invocation and preserve prior report bytes.

Field metadata and selected-team iteration list each read once; projections use only the closed standard-field allowlist, with no custom mapping, configuration or custom-field enrichment reads. Repeated same-project direct parents are read once in bounded optional batches or reused from inventory; children/ancestors/siblings/cross-project links are not enriched. Missing optional parent data yields limited coverage while existing mandatory context errors remain fatal; verify every requested projection field.

Injected confirmed optional Forbidden response is inaccessible with safe reason/next action; confirmed transient 429/5xx or invalid second page is partial, never absent. Unauthorized, CLI sign-in failure, unknown prefixes and body text containing misleading Forbidden are fatal. Assert zero raw stderr, identity or authentication material reaches normalized evidence and no failed inventory is downgraded.

The enriched inventory still writes through the current Azure report with native ordering and exact selected-item counts; resolver ambiguity makes zero new reads. Existing GitHub inventory/analysis/read-only instruction contract and embedded script/declaration payloads remain intact.

End-to-end synthetic collect → evidence-linked analyses → writer proves all five approved scenarios with exact ID order, specific Why now and recommendation/action, every cited field/comment/version/date/parent linkage, native urgency, and no duplicated Analysis prose. Every member appears once, each analysis runs once at <=5 concurrent calls, related context remains non-inventory and all counts agree.

Complete/limited/empty/UNASSESSED reports retain literal states, four Azure sections, explicit signal coverage plus reason/next action, no numeric confidence, no unknown-source claims and no false absence of blockers. A selected-team sprint with no dates supplies only planning context; an already returned custom date visibly preserves its reference name/value with unrecognized semantics and cannot supply a commitment, promotion or guaranteed-delivery claim. Disagreement stays visible.

Hostile comments, custom-field names, iteration paths, parent values, claim excerpts and action/reason strings render inert via shared escaping/redaction. Raw/encoded credential assignments, userinfo and unsafe links never become active content; Board item evidence links use existing safe routes with comment ID/version labels, not guessed deep links. Known benign near-matches remain visible.

Unknown/mismatched sources, unsafe required claim links, missing/invalid analyses, inventory failures, render failures and injected atomic write/replace failures retain prior report byte-for-byte and do not return success. Confirmed optional limited signals can publish only labeled safe output. Existing hierarchy, GitHub contract, template shell and file-identity cleanup regressions stay green.

not_tested: No tests or production source are written by this Phase-1 plan; existing tests run only as a planning baseline.
No live Azure tenant, account, sign-in or authentication queries and no real backlog/personal-data fixtures. Future production reads require separate authorization.

No invented role, database, uniqueness, 409/422 or write-race cases: this is a read-only CLI adapter/report, with no product API/database. Applicable authorization, malformed-read, continuation, count-drift and atomic-write paths are covered above.

No Azure DevOps Server, alternate-team iteration discovery, multiple-board report, ancestor/sibling traversal, state-policy change, weighted score, numeric confidence, custom field mapping/extensibility (including per-run mapping) or GitHub behavior change.
No dedicated @playwright/test dependency: existing capture.cjs drives the visual gate and screenshots. Pure content/ranking/safety assertions stay in Bun unit/integration tests.
No production loading/error HTML: the artifact is written atomically after collection/analysis, and fatal errors preserve the prior report. That behavior belongs to integration tests.

Source-reference validation proves provenance, not semantic truth of arbitrary analysis. Exact synthetic grounded conclusions and independent adversarial review cover that boundary; no test can certify every future natural-language claim.
